mechanism: Dapagliflozin increases urinary glucose and may affect mineral metabolism; vitamin D regulates calcium-phosphate homeostasis which can be altered by SGLT2 inhibitors, potentially increasing risk of diabetic ketoacidosis and bone loss.
action: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, and bone mineral density in patients on chronic dapagliflozin therapy; ensure adequate vitamin D supplementation and counsel on euglycemic DKA risk.
